Shellos

Water

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Shellos is a Water-type Sea Slug Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 6.3 kg. It evolves into Gastrodon. Its highest base stat is HP (76), with a base stat total of 325.
